Overview

Arequipa is a city in AR with a population of 1,000,000. The White City of Peru, a stunning colonial city built from volcanic sillar stone beneath three majestic volcanoes. Housing costs are close to the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 6b growing zone supports Cool to mild — apples, pears, berries, many vegetables. The city enjoys abundant sunshine, with about 260 sunny days a year. The population skews young, with a median age of 30.0.
